For intact host-input-device reuse, first read the mission's intact-reuse-spec, then run intact_reuse to produce/test a software review bundle even while physical evidence is missing; read its run and download runs/{name}/bundle. This does not count as a device_plan/device_engineering pass or READY. For catalog readiness, run device_plan first and device_engineering after a clean plan. Do not claim a prior check is current after repair or new evidence. Read the returned hashed artifact for details.
